name: Abhisekam
description: Shiva Abhisekam. Please Collect your Prasadam before 11.00 am if you are planning to visit the temple. Prasadam will not be available after 11.00 am.

name: Annadanam(100)
description: Annadanam (100 people) One day, includes Kanduvas, Blouse piece, Archana

name: Chandi Homam
timing: 9:30 AM Pournami day (ONLY ON FULL MOON DAY)
description: Chandi Homam is performed only on Pournami day (ONLY ON FULL MOON DAY). Devotees are advised to choose only pournami day for Chandi Homam sevas. Includes Kanduvas, Blouse piece, Pulihora, Bellam Pongali

name: Ghatam Alankaram (Ashada Jathara)
description: Ghatam Alankaram (Aashada Jathara): Flower decoration of Ammavari Ghatam with different kinds of flowers like kanakambaram, mallepullu, roses. Ghatam base will have neem leaf stalks. The ghatam will be smeared with turmeric paste.

name: Shaswatha Annadanam
description: Lifetime endowment contribution toward temple Annadanam service.

name: Shiva Archana
description: Standard archana service performed at the temple Shivalayam.

name: Nitya Annadanam
description: Nitya Annadanam – 1 day For 11 people, includes Archana, 200g Pulihora

name: Odibiyyam Offering
description: Odibiyyam Offering – Service Charges only. Devotees should bring the odibhiyam themselves

name: Online Bonam
description: Online Bonam will be offered by the temple staff on behalf of the devotees who wish to offer Bonam to Sri Ujjaini Mahakali Ammavaru. This service is available to all.

name: Shaswatha Pooja
description: Shaswatha Pooja Includes Pulihora, Kanduvas, Blouse piece

name: Veda Ashirvachanam
description: Veda Ashirvachanam Includes Kanduvas, Blouse piece, Laddu, Vada, Pulihora, Vastram
